note: What a thin surface must REFUSE to answer. Without these the suite only proves an implementation can compute what it can — never that it declines what it cannot. A min/max that answers here is the worst bug this system admits.

coverage.criterion: one case per refusal the algebra actually makes
coverage.why: one per reason, not exhaustive over inputs; a new reason needs a new case

cases.name: a level nobody declared
cases.why: a guessed level produces a real verdict about the wrong thing

cases.name: a unit impossible before anyone composed it
cases.why: nothing collided; one promise was written wrong, and calling that a collision hides the typo
